rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for taking a child or pet as your own.

example.english: We plan to adopt a dog.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 ling5 joeng5 jat1 zek3 gau2

rows.note: Use this for choosing a particular look, style, method, or approach as your own.

example.english: We decided to adopt this method.
example.traditional: 我哋決定採用呢個方法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 coi2 jung6 ni1 go3 fong1 faat3

rows.note: Use this for formally approving or taking up a view, proposal, or policy.

example.english: The board formally agreed to adopt this proposal.
example.traditional: 董事會正式採納咗呢項建議。
example.jyutping: dung2 si6 wui2 zing3 sik1 coi2 naap6 zo2 ni1 hong6 gin3 ji5
